name: Omnitech Engineering Limited
summary: Omnitech Engineering Limited engages in the manufacturing and supply of engineered components and assemblies worldwide. The company offers drilling, exploration, and refining products for upstream, midstream, and downstream applications, as well as braking systems, drive systems, and pumping units for renewable energy, electricity generation, and power production.
